criteria.reason: The client formula applies a single ×2 multiplier when either or both flags are enabled.
With only one flag enabled, the single multiplier doubles the resulting tonnage, equivalent to doubling that value.
The client display calculation is fixed, but the attempt also changed server-side tonnage calculations despite tonnage being display-only.
No database columns or migrations were added.
The harness reports all existing server and client tests pass.
A test was added, but the client unit assertion checks standalone arithmetic rather than exercising the production calculation.
